norms.what: Until 0.5.x this command was a per-transition audit of its own, with norms `N01`–`N63` and a pattern table; its norms now live, renumbered, in the `transition-audit` stage skills, and its table in the `sonnet-5-to-5-5` knowledge file, both with their history in git. The command keeps its name and arguments so no user's command or headless script breaks, and its new norm is numbered after the ids it defined so none is reused. Written for the transition-agnostic audit (#34, #42).
